clean_story:
Now I will teach you Happiness. It is the warm feeling in belly when fire burns bright and food fills stomach. It is the laugh that comes when friend slips on rock but is not hurt. It is the quiet joy when child sleeps safe in cave. It is the pride when spear brings down beast for tribe. It is the peace when sky is clear and wind is soft. It is the good feeling when all is right with world, this is Happiness.

Now go feel Joy, Love, Life.
